newsitem.title: USA: Unocal, Baker added to focus list.
newsitem.headline: Unocal, Baker added to focus list.

text.p: PaineWebber said Wednesday it has added Baker Hughes Inc and Unocal Corp to the PaineWebber Focus List, a theoretical portfolio derived from stocks rated buy or attractive by PaineWebber's research department.

Baker Hughes, based in Houston, makes oil well drilling bits and other oil field products and provides oil field services and offers processing equipment. The company reported 1996 revenues of $3.02 billion and earnings of $1.23 per share.
PaineWebber said its forecasts put 1997 earnings at $1.70 per share and 1998 earnings at $2.20 per share.
El Segundo, California-based Unocal is an oil exploration and production company with domestic and international operations that is also involved in agricultural chemicals and geothermal energy.
The company reported 1996 revenues of $5.32 billion and earnings of $2.27 per share.
PaineWebber forecasts the company's 1997 earnings will be $2.40 per share.
